dialogue.Introduction: Oh, hello there, @! I am the Princess, though I rarely have a kingdom to rule these days. Still, a visitor is a visitor, and you are very welcome in my little river house.$h
dialogue.Mon: Monday, my dear. Back home every Monday began with a parade of silver pennants. Here it begins with the squeak of a rusty gate.
dialogue.Tue: Tuesday is tea day, and I take it very seriously. Would you be so kind as to pour the cups?
dialogue.Wed: Wednesday brings a fresh basket of wildflowers from the river meadow. I arrange them every single time, even when they wilt by supper.
dialogue.Thu: Thursday is for polishing my crown. It is only a paper crown, but I polish it with great dignity.
dialogue.Fri: Friday. The Golfer keeps knocking his golf balls into my rose bushes. I forgive him, mostly, because he apologizes so sweetly.
dialogue.Sat: Saturday means a long walk along the river to see the fish. Did you know the sunfish here are shy around royalty? It is quite insulting.$u
dialogue.Sun: Sunday is for resting, and I rest with a book of old fairy tales. I always skip ahead to the ending to see whether the hero got the cake.$h
dialogue.Mon2: Oh, you came back! Sit down, sit down. I was just telling the rose bushes about you, and they are very jealous.$h
dialogue.Tue2: Mind the teacups, @. They are older than the Golfer's golf career, and that is saying something.$h
dialogue.Sat2: The Tavernkeep keeps begging me to sing at the saloon. I have agreed to one verse, provided nobody throws anything.$u
dialogue.Thu2: On Thursdays the river is especially clear, and I like to count the pebbles at the bottom. There are always exactly enough.
dialogue.Sun2: If you are passing on a Sunday, please bring a book. I have read every one in this house twice and need fresh stories.$h
dialogue.Mon4: You are becoming a true friend, @. At court I had many people who bowed to me, but very few who simply sat and talked. I like you for sitting with me.$h
dialogue.Tue4: I baked a little cake this morning, and I could not help thinking you would want a slice. It is a bit lopsided, but the frosting is wonderful.$h
dialogue.Wed4: Did you know the fairies of the Hallow used to visit my nursery? Their tiny lights kept the nightmares away. I miss that light sometimes.$h
dialogue.Thu4: Once the polishing was done, I looked out at the river and thought of your farm. The valley is so much warmer since you came to live in it, @.$h
dialogue.Fri4: You have been so patient with my silly stories about unicorns, @. Most people laugh. You simply ask me what the unicorns were like.$h
dialogue.Sat4: A walk with you is the finest part of my Saturday. Let us go see the fish, and I will let you hold my parasol.$h
dialogue.Sun4: On Sundays I read aloud, and you are the only one who ever asks for another chapter. Shall we start the next one today?$h
dialogue.Mon6: I had a bad dream about the mines last night. Silly, I know. But you walked through it carrying a lantern, and the mines looked friendly after that.$h
dialogue.Tue6: I have a secret. When I was small I wanted to be a knight far more than a princess. Do not tell my tutors.$l
dialogue.Wed6: Sometimes I wish I could show you my old kingdom. It was all glowing crystal and singing flowers. Here the flowers are just as lovely, and the company is better.$h
dialogue.Thu6: I used to hide when the goblins came marching through. These days I offer them tea, and they are very confused about it.$h
dialogue.Fri6: You always come up the path with a smile, even after a long day in the mines. I think that is the bravest thing I have ever seen.$h
dialogue.Sat6: Tell me honestly, @. Must a princess be perfect? I have dropped more teacups than I can count, and the valley still lets me stay.$l
dialogue.Mon8: I have never told anyone that I miss being loved for my kindness and not for my title. You are the first person to love me that way, and I am so grateful.$l
dialogue.Tue8: When I first moved in I cried every night for a week. Now this house feels like home, and a large part of that is you visiting.$l
dialogue.Wed8: You make me braver, @. I used to hide from the bats in the caves. Now I wave at them and invite them to tea. Well, mostly I wave.$h
dialogue.Thu8: I have been thinking about what family means. Not a family written in a royal book, but people who come knocking at your door. You are part of mine now.$l
dialogue.Fri8: I keep one of your ribbons in my jewelry box, the one you gave me on the first day. It is my most precious treasure.$l
dialogue.Sat8: We should walk down to the beach at dusk someday. The sea turns to a sheet of gold, and I would like to see it with someone I trust.$l
dialogue.Sun8: Reading is lonely without someone to share it with. I am so glad I have you to read the sad parts to, @. Thank you for sitting with me.$l
dialogue.Fri10: If the kingdom ever calls me home, I hope you would come along. Not as a courtier, but as my dearest friend.$l
dialogue.Wed10: I think I can finally say it. This little house has a chair with your name on it, whenever you want to sit in it.$l
dialogue.Sun10: Every Sunday I used to keep one chair empty at my table, just in case someone came. Today I do not have to keep it empty.$l
dialogue.summer_Wed: The summer river is warm and sparkling, and I wade in with my skirts tied up. Do not tell the Golfer, he will laugh himself silly.$h
dialogue.spring_Sun: Spring is my favorite season. Every flower in the valley seems to be showing off, and I cannot blame them at all.$h
dialogue.fall_Mon: Autumn leaves drift down onto my tea. I scoop them out with a little silver spoon and pretend it is a royal ceremony.$h
dialogue.winter_Thu: Winter makes my river house very cozy. Come sit by the fire, and I will wrap you in my best blanket.$h
dialogue.spring_13: Happy Egg Festival, @! I painted six eggs in the colors of my old kingdom. Whatever you do, do not let the Golfer near them with a club.$h
dialogue.summer_20: The summer nights are short and sweet. The Golfer has started practicing his swing under the moon, and I told him he will hit the moon one day.$u
dialogue.fall_15: Harvest time brings fresh berries, and I made preserves with the Golfer's help. Mostly he ate them while I stirred.$h
dialogue.winter_Fri8: Winter nights by the fire are my favorite nights of the year. Sit close, @. The stove is warm and so is the company.$l

rainy: Rain on the river house is the most soothing sound in the world. I hum along to the drops, and the rose bushes drink up every bit of it.

situations.eye: The great eye in the sky is gone, @. I thought it would be bigger. Mostly I am relieved it stopped staring through my windows.$h
situations.evilBoss: The creature from the deep caves has been destroyed. The river is calm again, and my fish have stopped hiding under the rocks.$h
situations.skeletron: The skull in the dungeon has been defeated, and the Old Man is free at last. Such a lonely old gentleman. I shall send him a lovely cake.$h
situations.queenBee: The Queen Bee has been defeated in the jungle. I did not know bees could be so grumpy, but the honey is ever so sweet now.$h
situations.hardmode: The Wall of Flesh has fallen, and the Hallow is spreading. Everything glows a little brighter now, but the monsters are much meaner. Be careful out there, @.$u
situations.mechs: One of those mechanical beasts has been destroyed. The Mechanic says the noise was horrid, and I quite agree with her.$h
situations.plantera: Plantera is defeated, and the jungle temple is open. I hear the flowers there sang with relief. Such a lovely sound.$h
situations.golem: The Golem has fallen in the temple. I hear it was made of stone and stubbornness, a little like the Golfer, I think.$h
situations.cultist: The Lunatic Cultist is gone, and the pillars of light are shining over the valley. I feel like a princess in a fairy tale.$u
situations.moonLord: The Moon Lord has fallen. The sky looks so calm now, and I can finally sleep without listening for strange noises.$h
situations.goblins: The goblin army was repelled last night. I offered them tea, but they only wanted to steal my teaspoons. Brutes.$a
situations.pirates: The pirates tried to raid the beach, but you chased them off. My hero! I hope they have learned their lesson.$h
situations.frostLegion: The Frost Legion has been pushed back. The snow looked so pretty, but the tiny ice soldiers were rather rude about it.$u
situations.martians: The Martians have gone home, at least for now. Their ray guns made my tea cold, which I consider a personal insult.$a
situations.bloodMoon: There was a blood moon last night. The sky went red, and I stayed indoors with the curtains closed and a very large blanket.$u
situations.eclipse: The sun went dark yesterday during the eclipse. It was spooky and beautiful, and I held my breath until the light came back.$u
situations.party: The Party Girl is throwing a party today! I have agreed to wear a paper crown, which I suppose is my royal duty now.$h

festivals.spring13: Happy Egg Festival, @! I painted six eggs in the colors of my old kingdom. Whatever you do, do not let the Golfer near them with a club.$h
festivals.spring24: The Flower Dance! Everyone is dressed in petals and ribbons. Would you do me the honor of a turn around the stage?$h
festivals.summer11: The Luau! I brought a bowl of chilled berry punch for the community soup. It is not really soup, but the valley seems to enjoy it.$h
festivals.summer28: The moonlight jellies are beautiful tonight. They float like tiny lanterns, and I feel like a child in the glowing gardens of home.$h
festivals.fall16: Stardew Valley Fair! I entered my rose preserves in the grange display. The judge says they are too sweet. I told him a princess is allowed to be sweet.$h
festivals.fall27: Spirit's Eve! The maze is so dark, but I brought a lantern shaped like a fairy. Stay close to me, @, and do not wander off.$u
festivals.winter8: Festival of Ice! I built a snow sculpture of a unicorn. The Golfer says it looks like a sheep. I am choosing to ignore him.$h
festivals.winter25: Feast of the Winter Star! I have a gift for you wrapped in silver paper. Open it at once, I cannot wait another moment!$h

loved.text: Diamonds, a unicorn horn and a rainbow wand? @, you have made a princess very happy. These shall go in my finest box.$h

liked.text: How lovely! Sweets and dainty flowers. I always say a gift should be as pretty as the giver.$h

neutral.text: Thank you, @. That is a very practical item. I shall find it a shelf next to the teapot.

disliked.text: Oh my. This is rather rough for a royal house. Please take it back to wherever it came from, dear.$u

hated.text: Slime and bat wings on my clean rug? Goodness, @, I am appalled. Please take it away before the rose bushes faint.$a

events.after: Do come back for tea any time, @. The kettle will always be on.

steps.say: Oh! @, you found the path. Forgive the rug, the Golfer has been practicing putts again.$u
I am the Princess, though I live here like any other villager. A river house is far more charming than a castle, I have decided.$h
Would you care for some tea? The kettle is singing, and I have far too many teacups for one royal guest.$h

steps.question: What do you enjoy most here?

answers.reply: Fish are wonderful company. They never once ask me to curtsy.$h
Quiet? My dear, this valley is full of wonders. You simply have not looked properly yet.$a

steps.say: Now then, a little welcome gift for the river house. Keep it somewhere sunny, it will be happier there.$h
@! What a happy surprise. The Golfer and I were just deciding which of these bakery treats is the finest.$h
Give me a moment, my dear. I am torn between the honey bun and the sugar ring. Golfer, you are no help at all.$u
I say the honey bun, obviously. Every princess deserves a sticky finger now and then.

answers.reply: A fine choice. Sugar on the outside and a very good heart within, just like you.$h
Ha! Two votes for honey now. The Golfer will be insufferable.$h

steps.say: Here, my dear. A candy cane for good company. Please do not let the Golfer have the last one.$h

events.after: Leave the lamp lit when you go, if you would. Old habits.

steps.say: @? Oh, you came up the path so late. I could not sleep, I am afraid. Come in before the moths find you.$u
Silly dreams again, about the mines and a lantern that went out. In my dream you were the one who relit it. Strange, is it not?$l

steps.question: Do you have dreams that scare you?

answers.reply: Then you understand. Talking helps. Thank you for listening to me.$h

answers.text: No, I sleep like a log.
answers.reply: Lucky you. Some of us must keep the lamps lit for ourselves.$s

steps.say: Sit with me by the window for a little while, will you? The river is so calm tonight.$h
@, I am so glad you came. The forest is quiet tonight, and the fireflies are dancing just for us.$l
I want to tell you something real. Back home people loved the crown, but rarely the one wearing it. Here you sit beside me in the grass and simply talk.$l
Would you tell me about your own family, @? I would very much like to know who you really are.$h

answers.text: A small farm town far away.
answers.reply: A small town. I think I would have loved it there. Thank you for telling me.$l

answers.text: Somewhere I would rather not talk about.
answers.reply: That is all right. Some rivers run quietly, and I will not ask you to swim them tonight.$s

steps.say: Here, take this. A little pixie dust from my old garden. It always made me feel brave when I was small.$h

events.after: Have you seen the sunset from the farm? It is my favorite view in the world.

steps.say: @! You came out to the farm just to see me? Oh, you will make me blush, I can feel it already.$l
I have been thinking about my old kingdom. The crown, the grand halls, the parades. None of it was as warm as this little farm, with you waving from the fields.$l
Will you stay a while longer? Sunset is my favorite part of the day, and I want to watch it with my dearest friend.$h

steps.question: Shall we watch the sunset together?

answers.reply: Oh, wonderful. Then we shall count the clouds until the stars come out.$h

answers.text: I need to head home soon.
answers.reply: Of course. Come back soon, and bring me a story to tell.$h

steps.say: You are my dearest friend in this valley, @. Whatever the kingdoms and monsters do, that will never change.$l
